description: This file contains transformation logic to convert between OpenAI-like embedding request/response format and AWS Bedrock Amazon Nova embedding format, supporting synchronous and asynchronous operations, multimodal inputs, and various configuration mappings.

classes.name: AmazonNovaEmbeddingConfig
classes.description: Configuration class that handles parameter mapping, request transformation, response parsing, and async invocation wrapping for Amazon Nova embeddings in a multimodal context.

methods.name: List[str] get_supported_openai_params(self)
methods.description: Returns list of supported OpenAI parameters for mapping.

methods.name: dict map_openai_params( self, non_default_params: dict, optional_params: dict )
methods.description: Maps OpenAI style parameters to Nova embedding parameters.

methods.name: dict _transform_request( self, input: str, inference_params: dict, async_invoke_route: bool = False, model_id: Optional[str] = None, output_s3_uri: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Transforms OpenAI style input and parameters into a Nova formatted embedding request, handling modality, dimension, and purpose mapping, as well as async invocation formatting.

methods.name: dict _wrap_async_invoke_request( self, model_input: dict, model_id: str, output_s3_uri: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Wraps a Nova embedding request into AWS Bedrock async invoke format, including model ID and output data configuration.

methods.name: EmbeddingResponse _transform_response( self, response_list: List[dict], model: str )
methods.description: Converts Nova embedding responses into OpenAI style EmbeddingResponse objects, estimating token counts.

methods.name: EmbeddingResponse _transform_async_invoke_response( self, response: dict, model: str )
methods.description: Transforms async invoke responses containing invocation ARN into OpenAI style EmbeddingResponse with hidden parameters.

ctags.name: _transform_request
ctags.signature: ( self, input: str, inference_params: dict, async_invoke_route: bool = False, model_id: Optional[str] = None, output_s3_uri: Optional[str] = None, )

ctags.name: _wrap_async_invoke_request
ctags.signature: ( self, model_input: dict, model_id: str, output_s3_uri: Optional[str] = None, )
